risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out together

risks.risk: Brand/model unknown, affecting part availability and resale value
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the brand/model label or nameplate on the unit

risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible voltage mismatch/needs adapter

proof_requests: Video of the washer powered on, showing motor running and water spraying under pressure
Close-up photo of the brand/model nameplate and serial number
Photo of all included accessories (gun, lance, hose, nozzles)
Photo of the plug and voltage rating sticker
Photo of the receipt and warranty card
Photos of the housing underside and any wear/damage spots
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item as a pressure washer, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified condition, accessories, and documentation.
